<div class="card-body">
'''Reserve Pilot''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Imperial]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">予備パイロット</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋1。ブラック2、ブラック3、またはブラック4に乗っているなら、回避値＋1となる上に、戦闘運命数を引けない場合も、1枚引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Reserve-Pilot-PSA-90960099.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">戦闘による負傷で第一線を退いたベイダー配下の精鋭タイ・パイロット。彼は交代要員として待機しており、いつでも死傷したパイロットの代わりを勤められる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Reserve Pilot.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots. If aboard Black 2, Black 3, or Black 4, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw 1 battle destiny if otherwise unable.

'''Lore:'''
An elite TIE pilot under Vader who left the front line because of combat injuries. He waits as a replacement and can take the place of a dead or wounded pilot at any time.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says he left the front line from combat injuries and can replace dead or wounded pilots.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Reserve Pilot]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
